posts.title: Building AI Agents in Python
posts.description: 2026 is shaping up to be a big year for AI agents. We are seeing more products where the AI not only answers a question but also does some work for the user. posts.title: Goodbye GIL - Exploring Free Threaded Python 3.14
posts.description: I compared execution time of code - which included CPU & I/O bound scripts and a WSGI app using the default and free-threaded Python 3.14 interpreters. This was for my talk: “Goodbye GIL - Exploring Free Threaded Mode in Python” at PyCon JP 2025 . posts.title: Vibe Coding with Junie - JetBrains AI Coding Agent
